en.t: Oborozukiyo returned to the palace in the seventh month.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝只因一向特别宠爱她，顾不得外人讥议，照旧常常要她伺候在侧。

en.t: Because Emperor Suzaku had always favored her so especially, he disregarded the criticism of others and still often kept her in attendance at his side.

units.source_text: 有时对她申恨诉怨，有时与她订盟立誓，其态度与容貌，非常温柔优美。

en.t: At times he poured out his resentment and grievances to her, and at times he exchanged vows with her; his manner and appearance were exceedingly gentle and graceful.

units.source_text: 然而胧月夜的心只管向往源氏公子，实在对不起朱雀帝。

en.t: Yet Oborozukiyo's heart kept longing only for Prince Genji, and in truth she wronged Emperor Suzaku.

units.source_text: 有一天，宫中举行管弦之会，朱雀帝对胧月夜说：“源氏公子不在座，颇有美中不足之感。

en.t: One day, when a concert of wind and string music was held in the palace, Emperor Suzaku said to Oborozukiyo, "With Prince Genji absent from the gathering, it feels as though something beautiful is lacking.

units.source_text: 何况比我思念更深的人，正不知有多少呢。

en.t: And who knows how many people miss him even more deeply than I do.

units.source_text: 似觉一切事物都暗淡无光了。”

en.t: It seems as if everything has grown dim and lost its brightness."

units.source_text: 后来垂泪叹道：“我终于违背了父皇的遗命！

en.t: Later, shedding tears, he sighed, "In the end I have gone against my father's dying command!
There is no escaping my guilt!"

units.source_text: 胧月夜也忍不住流下泪来。

en.t: Oborozukiyo too could not hold back her tears.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝又说：“我虽生在这世间，但觉毫无意趣，更不希望长生。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku went on, "Though I live in this world, I find no pleasure in it at all, and I do not wish for a long life.

units.source_text: 假令我就此死了，不知你作何感想？

en.t: If I were to die now, I wonder what you would feel.

units.source_text: 如果你觉得对我的死别不及对须磨那人的生离之可悲，我的灵魂真要吃醋呢！

en.t: If you felt that parting from me in death was less sorrowful than being separated in life from that man at Suma, my spirit would truly be jealous!

units.source_text: 古歌云：‘相思到死有何益，生前欢会胜黄金。’这是不解来世因缘的浅薄之人的话吧。”

en.t: An old poem says, 'What use is longing until death? A meeting while alive is worth more than gold.' Those must be the words of a shallow person who does not understand the bonds of the next life."

units.source_text: 他深感人世无常，但说时态度异常温存。

en.t: He felt deeply the impermanence of human life, yet as he spoke his manner was unusually tender.

units.source_text: 胧月夜也不禁珠泪滚滚而下。

en.t: Oborozukiyo also could not help letting pearl-like tears roll down.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝便道：“就是这样啊，你这眼泪是为谁流的呢？”

en.t: Emperor Suzaku then said, "So that is how it is. For whom are those tears of yours being shed?"
